steps.tx: **Tight junctions** (claudins, occludin, zonula occludens scaffolds) seal epithelial and endothelial sheets paracellularly, fence apical from basolateral membrane domains, and build the blood brain and blood testis barriers; claudin defects cause familial magnesium wasting (claudin 16 paracellin) and deafness (claudin 14), while Clostridium perfringens enterotoxin hijacks claudins to open guts. Freeze fracture strands count correlates with leakiness across epithelia.
steps.say: Tight junctions seal sheets and build blood brain barriers through claudins. Claudin defects waste magnesium or deafen, while toxins hijack claudins to open guts pathologically.

rows: Deafness, Charcot-Marie-Tooth X, lens cataract forms

steps.tx: **Gap junctions** dock two connexons into aqueous channels passing ions, second messengers and metabolites under one kilodalton between neighbours, electrically coupling heart and uterine smooth muscle and synchronising hepatocytes and lens fibres; gating by pH, calcium and phosphorylation isolates injured cells. Connexin 26 dominates cochlea (commonest hereditary deafness gene GJB2) and connexin 32 myelinating Schwann cells (X linked Charcot-Marie-Tooth), rewarding exact connexin geography.
steps.say: Gap junctions pass ions and messengers between neighbours, coupling heart and uterus electrically. Connexin 26 dominates cochlea and connexin 32 Schwann cells, rewarding exact geography in examinations.

steps.tx: Desmosomes rivet intermediate filaments between cells resisting shear (skin, heart), and their autoimmunity is finals gold: **pemphigus vulgaris** antibodies to desmoglein 3 (mucosal dominant) plus 1 split epidermis suprabasally (flaccid bullae, Nikolsky positive, tombstone basal layer), while bullous pemphigoid antibodies to hemidesmosomal BP antigens split subepidermally (tense bullae, Nikolsky negative). Arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy desmosomal gene defects (plakophilin, desmoplakin) translate the same rivets to sudden death cardiology.
steps.say: Pemphigus splits desmosomes suprabasally with flaccid bullae, while pemphigoid splits hemidesmosomes subepidermally with tense bullae. Desmosomal gene defects cause arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy and sudden death.

steps.tx: **Microtubule** motors give direction its meaning: kinesins walk mostly to plus ends (outward, anterograde axonal transport, mitotic spindle), cytoplasmic dynein walks to minus ends (retrograde, organelle centring, intraflagellar return whose failure causes ciliopathies from Bardet-Biedl to polycystic kidneys). Colchicine and vinca drugs depolymerise or freeze dynamics against gout and cancer mitoses, taxanes stabilise polymer to the same antimitotic end, a paired pharmacology stems rotate annually.
steps.say: Kinesins walk outward and dynein walks inward along microtubules, powering axonal transport and cilia. Colchicine, vinca drugs and taxanes attack dynamics against gout and cancer mitoses together.

steps.tx: Red cell membrane skeleton is the clinical cytoskeleton: alpha and beta **spectrin**, ankyrin (band 3 anchor), actin junctions and protein 4.1/4.2 brace the lipid bilayer against shear for 120 days of capillary squeezing. Hereditary spherocytosis (ankyrin, spectrin, band 3, protein 4.2 vertical linkage failures) loses surface as vesicles, spheres cells, raises MCHC, lyses in spleen (splenectomy cures haemolysis, not shape) and shows increased osmotic fragility with pink test logic.
steps.say: Spectrin and ankyrin brace the red cell membrane against shear. Spherocytosis loses surface and lyses in spleen, showing increased osmotic fragility. Splenectomy cures haemolysis, not shape.

rows: PNH: complement lysis, no shape fault

steps.tx: **Membrane protein topology** closes the module: single pass (receptors), multipass (GPCR seven transmembrane serpentines, transporters), beta barrel (mitochondrial and bacterial outer membranes), lipid anchored (GPI, prenylated Ras farnesyl whose transferase inhibitors were oncology lessons), and peripheral (spectrin, kinases). Signal sequences, stop transfer and glycosylation sequons (N-X-S/T) decide topology co-translationally, so one primary sequence predicts orientation, domains and druggable pockets before any structure is solved.
steps.say: Topology is decided co-translationally by signal and stop transfer sequences, so one primary sequence predicts orientation and druggable pockets. This closes membranes and opens carbohydrate chemistry next.

nodes.label: Signal sequence targets ribosome to ER
